notes: Off-converter layout. Silk has no JS/React component library — the source is 12 self-contained HTML+CSS mockups, so there is no dist/ to bundle and no _ds_bundle.js. The design language is shipped instead: tokens/ + _ds_bundle.css (extracted verbatim from the mockups, namespaced silk-*), reachable from styles.css. Preview cards are the original mockups, unmodified. See .design-sync/NOTES.md.
